title: Zero to First Agent: Microsoft Foundry + Azure Open AI (Sep. 2026 Edition)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework and how we get from zero to first agent,
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這段 AI 與 C# 影片。我們要用 Microsoft Agent Framework，從零開始建立第一個代理程式，

cues.en: user either Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 並分別使用 Microsoft Foundry 與 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: I've made this video in the past, but various things have changed in the last 11 months.
cues.zh: 以前我錄過這個主題，但過去 11 個月有不少事情改變了。

cues.en: So I wanted to make an update and also include both Foundry and Azure OpenAI to show the difference in this video.
cues.zh: 所以想錄一段更新，並同時介紹 Foundry 與 Azure OpenAI，在影片中比較兩者的差異。

cues.en: So let's get going into figuring out how we get from absolutely zero to first agent.
cues.zh: 現在就來看看，如何從完全空白的狀態建立第一個代理程式。

cues.en: So what I have here is a small NuGet package.
cues.zh: 這裡先準備了一個小型 NuGet 專案。

cues.en: And the only thing I put in is a little bit of text here and two options because we're going to cover both Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 我只放了一點文字和兩個選項，因為我們會同時介紹 Azure OpenAI 與 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: Because both of them come from the Foundry portal here, which you can go and grab your Foundry.
cues.zh: 兩者都從這個 Foundry 入口網站建立，你可以在這裡建立 Foundry 資源。

cues.en: You need an Azure subscription.
cues.zh: 首先需要 Azure 訂閱。

cues.en: And if you don't have a Foundry project yet, you simply go up here or it will actually pop up this screen to you.
cues.zh: 如果還沒有 Foundry 專案，點這裡建立，或是系統會直接顯示這個畫面。

cues.en: And you can give it a name.
cues.zh: 在這裡填上名稱。

cues.en: I will just leave it at this because this resource I will delete again.
cues.zh: 我先保留這個名稱，因為這個資源之後還會刪掉。

cues.en: But you will, of course, put in your right one, put in the right name for the resource, the region.
cues.zh: 實際使用時，請填入合適的資源名稱和區域。

cues.en: I use Sweden Central because it has most capabilities together with US East.
cues.zh: 我使用 Sweden Central，因為它和 US East 一樣，支援的功能比較齊全。

cues.en: You put in your subscription and your resource group.
cues.zh: 再選擇訂閱和資源群組。

cues.en: One thing I normally tend to turn off is the app insights.
cues.zh: 我通常會關閉 Application Insights。

cues.en: I don't feel like I need that, but you could keep it on if you want to do more auditing and traceability.
cues.zh: 我目前不太需要，但如果你想做更多稽核和追蹤，可以保留開啟。

cues.en: But I will just start creating this and then we'll quickly look a little more in the code.
cues.zh: 先開始建立資源，接著回頭看看程式碼。

cues.en: Because we have two options when we get into our portal, and that is to use it as either Azure OpenAI or as Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 因為進入入口網站後，有兩種使用方式：Azure OpenAI，或 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: And the key difference between them is how you authenticate.
cues.zh: 兩者最主要的差異是認證方式。

cues.en: If you go for Azure OpenAI, you do a more direct model.
cues.zh: 選擇 Azure OpenAI，就是比較直接的模型存取方式。

cues.en: And that way you get an API key, and you simply just use it as a normal API request response.
cues.zh: 你會拿到 API 金鑰，像一般 API 一樣送出請求、取得回應。

cues.en: Nothing is saved up in the portal in any way.
cues.zh: 入口網站不會保存這些對話內容。

cues.en: If you go with Microsoft Foundry, you will be able to see traces.
cues.zh: 使用 Microsoft Foundry 則可以查看追蹤記錄。

cues.en: You can make more advanced agents like declarative agents and hosted agents, all of which I cover in other videos here.
cues.zh: 也能建立宣告式代理程式、託管代理程式等進階功能，我在其他影片都有介紹。

cues.en: But the main thing that is with Microsoft Foundry is that in that we only go with the RBAC version,
cues.zh: 不過 Microsoft Foundry 的主要差異是，它只使用 RBAC，

cues.en: the Role-Based Access Control, meaning you need to log in with your Microsoft account or some way to authenticate against Azure
cues.zh: 也就是角色型存取控制。你必須使用 Microsoft 帳號登入，或透過某種方式向 Azure 驗證身分，

cues.en: that is not just a simple API key.
cues.zh: 而不是只提供一把簡單的 API 金鑰。

cues.en: Most people find this more secure, while this is more convenient for testing.
cues.zh: 多數人認為 RBAC 比較安全，API 金鑰則比較方便測試。

cues.en: In my day-to-day, I normally use Azure OpenAI, but both of them can do exactly the same.
cues.zh: 平常工作時，我通常使用 Azure OpenAI，但兩者都能做到相同的事情。

cues.en: So if we look up in the portal, we have our resource ready.
cues.zh: 回到入口網站，資源已經建立好了。

cues.en: And we get an API key and project endpoint and an Azure OpenAI input.
cues.zh: 這裡有 API 金鑰、專案端點，以及 Azure OpenAI 端點。

cues.en: So if we want to use API keys, we need the key and the OpenAI endpoint.
cues.zh: 如果要使用 API 金鑰，需要金鑰和 OpenAI 端點。

cues.en: While if we go to RBAC route, we only need the project input.
cues.zh: 如果走 RBAC 的方式，只需要專案端點。

cues.en: So I'm going to grab this endpoint and simply just save it here in the first option.
cues.zh: 先複製這個端點，放進第一個選項裡。

cues.en: So we're going to say string endpoint equals this endpoint.
cues.zh: 也就是宣告 string endpoint，值設成這個端點。

cues.en: And we're going to get our API key.
cues.zh: 再取得 API 金鑰。

cues.en: And now I'm going to do something you should not do, and that is paste the API key in here, and you will be able to see my API key.
cues.zh: 接下來我要做一件你不應該做的事：直接把 API 金鑰貼進來，所以你會看到我的金鑰。

cues.en: I'm okay with that because I'm going to delete these resources before this video is released.
cues.zh: 我敢這樣做，是因為會在影片發布前刪除這些資源。

cues.en: So this API key is not valid anymore.
cues.zh: 所以你看到影片時，這把 API 金鑰已經失效。

cues.en: But in real life, you should of course put it in user secrets, environment variables, or keywords.
cues.zh: 實際開發時，當然應該把它放在使用者秘密、環境變數或 Key Vault 裡。

cues.en: The final thing we need before we can do this is we need a model.
cues.zh: 開始之前，最後還需要一個模型。

cues.en: And in our case, we will use the ChatGPT 5.6 Lunar model.
cues.zh: 這裡使用的是 ChatGPT 5.6 Lunar 模型。

cues.en: It's a cheap model.
cues.zh: 它是一個費用較低的模型。

cues.en: As of this recording, 6 is already out, but it's not really available fully on Azure yet.
cues.zh: 錄製時，6 版已經推出，但 Azure 尚未全面提供。

cues.en: It will be available in a couple of days.
cues.zh: 應該過幾天就會提供。

cues.en: But we're going to use this one, but the sample will be the same.
cues.zh: 這裡先使用這個模型，範例的做法不會改變。

cues.en: The sample will be the same.
cues.zh: 範例是一樣的。

cues.en: And you might not even be able with a brand new account to get access to Lunar.
cues.zh: 如果你是全新的帳號，甚至可能還沒有 Lunar 的存取權。

cues.en: You might only be able to get access to older models.
cues.zh: 可能只能使用比較舊的模型。

cues.en: Doesn't really matter. It will still work.
cues.zh: 這沒有關係，一樣能運作。

cues.en: But I have some access up here for Lunar, so I'm going to do that.
cues.zh: 我的帳號已經能存取 Lunar，所以這裡使用它。

cues.en: And in order to do get access to it, we need to go to the Build tab here and go to Models.
cues.zh: 要取得模型，先到 Build 頁籤，再進入 Models。

cues.en: Because right now, my Azure account here is not associated with any models at all.
cues.zh: 目前這個 Azure 帳號還沒有連結任何模型。

cues.en: So I need to go to Deploy here and say Deploy Space Model.
cues.zh: 所以到 Deploy，選擇部署基礎模型。

cues.en: This is different from OpenAI, where you just give the name, because we can choose when we do this and deploy,
cues.zh: 這和 OpenAI 直接填模型名稱不同，因為在部署時，

cues.en: we can override the name to something else.
cues.zh: 我們可以把部署名稱改成其他名稱。

cues.en: So it can be associated with a specific app, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，可以讓名稱對應某個特定應用程式。

cues.en: So up here, there's a deployment name, which will default to what it is, but we could write anything up here if we want to.
cues.zh: 這裡有 Deployment Name，預設是模型名稱，但也能改成你想要的名稱。

cues.en: I choose normally global standards, but there might be some legal requirements that need for you to go into the data zone standards instead,
cues.zh: 我通常選 Global Standard，不過某些法規要求可能需要改用 Data Zone Standard，

cues.en: so it keeps within a certain region.
cues.zh: 確保資料留在特定區域內。

cues.en: You then put in your tokens per limits.
cues.zh: 再設定 Token 的速率上限。

cues.en: You might get fewer than me, the normal I've seen is 30,000, here's 250,000, because I have had my account for a long time,
cues.zh: 你的額度可能比我少。我通常看到的是 30,000，這裡有 250,000，因為我的帳號已使用很久，

cues.en: I've slowly gotten more and more quota.
cues.zh: 額度逐漸增加了。

cues.en: But you might even have zero here, then you need to choose a different model or ask for quota using the quota buttons that are in here.
cues.zh: 這裡甚至可能是零，那就得改選其他模型，或使用這裡的配額按鈕申請額度。

cues.en: But I'm luckily able to just get this model, so I will deploy it.
cues.zh: 幸好我可以直接使用這個模型，現在就部署。

cues.en: Deploying it doesn't really cost me anything, it's only when I use it, so it's not like I'm now paying per second for something or anything.
cues.zh: 部署本身不會產生這類使用費，用到模型時才會計費，不是部署後就開始按秒收費。

cues.en: I'm just deploying it, so we can grab the name while we wait,
cues.zh: 目前只是部署，等待時先複製模型名稱，

cues.en: and we already put it in.
cues.zh: 把它填進程式碼裡。

cues.en: So once this is deployed, normally it doesn't take this long, so let's just continue and then see if it doesn't deploy.
cues.zh: 通常部署不會花這麼久。先繼續做其他步驟，等等再看看是否完成。

cues.en: Because now we have the tree information in order to do an agent, but we need a NuGet package,
cues.zh: 現在建立代理程式所需的三項資訊都有了，但還需要一個 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: and that NuGet package is microsoft.agents.azure.openai in order to do the Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 使用 Azure OpenAI 時，需要 Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI 這個套件。

cues.en: In the old days, you would use an Azure OpenAI package instead, but that is deprecated now, so we use the direct package from OpenAI
cues.zh: 以前會使用 Azure OpenAI 套件，但現在那個做法已被棄用，所以透過這個架構直接使用 OpenAI 套件。

cues.en: through the system.
cues.zh: 也就是直接使用 OpenAI 的套件。

cues.en: So just needed to search, and we find it here.
cues.zh: 搜尋一下，就能在這裡找到。

cues.en: We are in version 1.22 as of this recording, and we are going to accept that we have access.
cues.zh: 錄製時的版本是 1.22，接受安裝並取得使用權。

cues.en: So now we need to make a client that can work with Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 接下來建立一個能和 Azure OpenAI 通訊的用戶端。

cues.en: So in order to do that, we say simply make an OpenAI client, and we could put in the API key here,
cues.zh: 可以直接建立 OpenAIClient，並把 API 金鑰放進來，

cues.en: but then we will go directly against OpenAI and not Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 但那樣會連到 OpenAI，而不是 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: So instead, we are going to use the API key credentials here and put in the API key, and then we need to add these extra options
cues.zh: 所以改用 ApiKeyCredential 包住 API 金鑰，並加上額外選項，

cues.en: because in the options, we can set the endpoint, which is our dedicated deployment endpoint for our Azure.
cues.zh: 因為可以在選項中指定端點，也就是 Azure 資源專屬的部署端點。

cues.en: What we get out of this is an OpenAI client that is ready for us to use against our resource,
cues.zh: 這樣就會取得已設定好、可存取我們資源的 OpenAIClient，

cues.en: and we can see our model has now deployed as well, so that's okay.
cues.zh: 而且模型現在也已經部署完成，沒有問題。

cues.en: Once we have our client, we simply just say that we need to get what type of underlying client, like audio, image, and so on,
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，指定要使用哪一種底層用戶端，例如音訊、影像等等，

cues.en: and what we're going to go for is the responses client.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 ResponsesClient。

cues.en: For texts, OpenAI have two, and Azure in proxy, both have chat client and responses client,
cues.zh: OpenAI 的文字介面有兩種，Azure 也透過代理提供：ChatClient 與 ResponsesClient。

cues.en: but the responses client is the new one, which is more capable.
cues.zh: ResponsesClient 是較新的版本，能力也更完整。

cues.en: It has all the features while you end up hitting certain limitations with the old one.
cues.zh: 它支援完整功能，舊的介面則會遇到某些限制。

cues.en: This one also have a compiler warning on it because it's still in preview, despite being quite stable at the moment,
cues.zh: 這個功能目前仍在預覽階段，所以編譯器會提出警告，雖然目前其實已經相當穩定。

cues.en: so what I just added is a small pragma warning disabled in order to get rid of that compile error,
cues.zh: 因此我加上一個 pragma warning disable，把這個編譯警告關掉。

cues.en: and once I have that, I can simply say, as AI agent, and this is a little extension methods from Microsoft AI,
cues.zh: 接著就可以呼叫 AsAIAgent，這是 Microsoft AI 提供的小型擴充方法。

cues.en: and the only thing we need to set on this is the model, so we say model equals model, but we can also set instructions, tools, and all kinds of things,
cues.zh: 這裡唯一必須設定的是模型，也就是 model。當然也能設定指示、工具與各種選項，

cues.en: and that's covered in all the other videos I have on this channel.
cues.zh: 其他影片都會介紹這些內容。

cues.en: We then get a chat client agent out, and if we want to use the generic word for them, it's just AI agents.
cues.zh: 這樣會取得 ChatClientAgent。如果用通稱來表示，就是 AIAgent。

cues.en: Once we have an agent, we simply say run async, and we ask our question, so what is the capital of France?
cues.zh: 有了代理程式，只要呼叫 RunAsync，再問問題，例如「法國的首都是哪裡？」。

cues.en: Of course, we don't really like to make a chat loop, but we're just testing here.
cues.zh: 這裡只是測試，所以不建立完整的對話迴圈。

cues.en: We're going to say a wait, and we get a response back, so this response is an advanced object
cues.zh: 加上 await，就能取得回應。回應是一個功能豐富的物件，

cues.en: with all kinds of things that we cover in other videos, but essentially, it also just have the text, which is also just the two-string method,
cues.zh: 包含各種後續影片會介紹的資訊。不過基本上也有文字，而 ToString 也會回傳這段文字，

cues.en: so we can simply say console.writeline response, and we should be up and running.
cues.zh: 所以直接 Console.WriteLine(response)，應該就能運作了。

cues.en: We can also do streaming, so if we say agent.runAsyncStreaming
cues.zh: 也可以使用串流，例如呼叫 agent.RunStreamingAsync，

cues.en: and ask a different question, how to make soup,
cues.zh: 改問另一個問題：「如何煮湯？」。

cues.en: we can then, instead of just a wait, we need a wait for each, and we get an update, meaning an update is more or less one word at a time,
cues.zh: 此時不能只寫 await，而要使用 await foreach，逐次取得更新，大致上每次收到一個字或一小段文字，

cues.en: so we simply say console.write instead of writeline for the update in order to get a streaming result back.
cues.zh: 因此對每次更新使用 Console.Write，而非 WriteLine，就能呈現串流結果。

cues.en: Just to keep it easy to see what is the different one, I will just put in this between, so this is all we need.
cues.zh: 為了方便分辨兩種結果，我在中間加上這段分隔文字。這就是全部所需的程式碼。

cues.en: We need a client, an agent, and call it using runAsync or runStream.
cues.zh: 建立用戶端、建立代理程式，再透過 RunAsync 或串流方法呼叫。

cues.en: So if we run this code, we will be able to see.
cues.zh: 執行這段程式，應該就能看到結果。

cues.en: It's running.
cues.zh: 程式正在執行。

cues.en: That will come back with the word Paris or the capital to Paris, and then we can see a streaming version of the other question on how to make soup.
cues.zh: 先回傳「巴黎」或「法國的首都是巴黎」，接著以串流方式回答如何煮湯。

cues.en: So that is very cool. It is up and running.
cues.zh: 很棒，現在已經能正常運作。

cues.en: So if you want to just use API keys, you can stop now, but if you want to do more advanced with Microsoft Foundry, let's try to do that.
cues.zh: 如果只想使用 API 金鑰，到這裡就夠了。如果想使用 Microsoft Foundry 的進階方式，接著一起看看。

cues.en: We use the same resource, we use the same model, but we use a different NuGet package.
cues.zh: 一樣使用相同資源與模型，但改用不同的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: That is, instead of OpenAI up here, we use the Foundry package.
cues.zh: 也就是把上面的 OpenAI 套件換成 Foundry 套件。

cues.en: So we need to install that, and this package is in pre-release, so you need to say include pre-release in order to get it.
cues.zh: 需要安裝它，而且目前是預先發布版本，所以要勾選 Include Prerelease 才找得到。

cues.en: You can see it's still version 1.22, but in a preview state.
cues.zh: 可以看到版本仍是 1.22，但目前處於預覽狀態。

cues.en: We install that one, and down here, instead of an OpenAI client,
cues.zh: 安裝好之後，在這裡不用 OpenAIClient，

cues.en: we simply make an AI project client.
cues.zh: 改成建立 AIProjectClient。

cues.en: Even newer files, and it requires an endpoint, so new UI with our endpoint, and the endpoint we don't have yet.
cues.zh: 這是比較新的類別，需要一個端點，因此建立 Uri 並傳入端點，但我們目前還沒複製它。

cues.en: So let's quickly wrap it up here.
cues.zh: 先快速把它取回來。

cues.en: So on the home, we had the endpoint here, which is the project endpoint, because we are using a project client here.
cues.zh: 首頁這裡就有 Project Endpoint，因為現在使用的是專案用戶端。

cues.en: String endpoint.
cues.zh: 宣告 string endpoint。

cues.en: So that is where we are going.
cues.zh: 這就是要連線的位置。

cues.en: Now we need our credentials, and in here, we simply use the normal RBAC credentials.
cues.zh: 接著需要認證，這裡直接使用一般的 RBAC 認證。

cues.en: There is the Azure default credentials down here, which is the fallback of all of them.
cues.zh: 可以使用這裡的 DefaultAzureCredential，它會依序嘗試各種認證方式。

cues.en: You can go with client secret, all the different ones.
cues.zh: 也可以用 Client Secret 等其他認證方式。

cues.en: I tend to, when I'm just sitting here and coding, use the Azure CLI credentials, because I have those installed.
cues.zh: 我在本機寫程式時，通常使用 AzureCliCredential，因為已經安裝了 Azure CLI。

cues.en: So I'd have the AC command to run, and if you see my account, I've logged in already,
cues.zh: 所以可以執行 az 指令。查看帳號，可以看到我已經登入，

cues.en: so I have made this machine able to connect to my azure.ai.com,
cues.zh: 因此這部電腦可以連線到 Azure AI 入口網站，

cues.en: and for that reason, also access to this system.
cues.zh: 也因此可以存取這個系統。

cues.en: But up in the project itself, you would, of course, give the right people the right access in order to do this.
cues.zh: 不過，在專案端仍然需要把正確的存取權授予適當的人員。

cues.en: We get a client, and this client doesn't need to choose between various different sub-clients like responses,
cues.zh: 取得這個用戶端後，不需要再選 Responses、

cues.en: chat client, image client, because it already is a response client.
cues.zh: ChatClient、ImageClient 等子用戶端，因為它本身就提供 Responses 的能力。
